essence: Every seen bliss a droplet of the bliss-sea god.
Blessed chanters dropping all talk but Śiva's name.
Want-free apportioner of endless wants, beginningless world's feaster.
Flawless taproot sought by none; remembrance lucidity hymned.
Lone unbroken sway unfolding fall and rise; filth aimed turns sterling.
Fist-caught, sight-caught, never slipped: drunk runners reach the Matted One.
Beyond verse, formula, chant, bright, farther: deep-fair knowable.
Law, start, close of worlds; duties march from none else.

sections.SUMMARY: All delight runs dropwise from one sea. Luckiest throats abandon gossip for the Name mumbled glad-drunk. Hungerless, he deals out hungers and dines though the cosmos never started; faultless root, he wants no hire, yet recall lights skulls that praise. Single sway nods worlds down and up; mud slung his way gilds. Fists and eyes seize him — unseizable — till love-besotted sprinters tackle the Tanglehead. Past metre, mantra, moonstuff, past pastness, his lore-body glows grave and gracious; code, dawn, dusk of the world are him, and duty's columns issue from nowhere else.

rasa.justification: Drop and sea, fist and flight, mud and gilding: contraries held in one vastness, marveled into refuge.

essence: Breaker and uncoverer of churned stupor: gnosis-bliss without pairs.
Māyā-filcher in one blink: protect.
Bearer of freedom's road, wisdom's crown, hunger's ridge: lord.
Brahmā in you; unlorded by none; measure past measure.
Kin, comrades, patrons nothing; you haul from birth-sea everywhere.
Heaven-dew discipline-beads conquer, rinsing folly's stain.
Chant-sung thought-blaze urged straight; eight-bodied asked for lasting ground or all.
Name alone perfects to release; ever-reset painted world amazes the keen.

sections.SUMMARY: Conjure and crack the churned daze: joy-knowledge twinless. Blink-snatch the veil — shield us. Shoulder the triple crown of quit-smoke, clear wit, spent craving: mastery. Even Firstborn finds his First in you; no chief unchiefs you; bliss upon bliss who shall plumb? Blood and bond weigh nil; one Lifter works all harbours. Discipline-drawn dew outcleanses dumps of dark. Gāyatrī's glow goads wits true; eight limbs entreated yield one foothold or the fair. Bare naming outdoes doing; the repainted play stuns each fine mind.

rasa.justification: Haul, shield, rinse, goad, grant, stun: sheltering acts met with daring trust.

essence: Hard made handy, bitter sweetened: sole-valiant memory minds love's bane.
Hymns singing the high one thrill the great at his bare name.
As you, indeed you, in the beyond: power-hosts launch and close triple worlds.
Spell, spell-fit, spell-master: hand the spell making me spellbound.
Light-shaped vow-true self mine, yet drifter-dream — how in you?
Unsnapped, unchurlish, single, sound: fruit-stakers' fortune in you.
Darling able to crush ills and deal boons on the bull-flag.
Love the last salve rinsing filmed god-sight.
Fear-free bliss-one unwasting planted: come quick, why linger?
Bottomless grim rounds-sea; high crosser: great Master.

sections.SUMMARY: One recall steadies the staggering and sugars gall. Anthems to the Tallest raise gooseflesh at syllable one. Be as you be beyond: battalions of force unfurl and furl the threefold. Charm, charm-worthy, charmer — deal the charm that charms me yours. Glow-cast, pledge-fast — myself in you, yet castaway in dream: what sleep lodges in waking? Whole, seemly, sole, sane: your settled fortune funds the trusting. Dearly he smites sorrows and signs fortunes from the horned banner. Last balm of love films clear the filmed god-eye. Dread-free delight, solo, deathless: step in now, tarry never. Fathomless and fearsome the swim; ferry it — Lofty, someone, Master.

rasa.dominant: śṛṅgāra-bhakti with karuṇā (love pleading through dread)
rasa.sthayibhava: rati under fear of the sea
rasa.justification: Gall, dream, sleep, swim, tarry: dread named and crossed by love-sapped pleading.
